body:
> Do you have other naming ideas for "count"? Maybe "activeFacetsValues" or smg adding context to what is the count about.

I had the same question, but I settled for `count` because this is what we use in the `RefinementListItem`, but I'm ok changing. Especially considering this is the number of currently selected facets, not the count of hits for thoses facets. So maybe `refinedFacetsCount`? We already use `isRefined` in the `RefinementList` template.
